title: Evaluating Causal Reasoning in LLMs: A Case Study in the Challenges of Procedural Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.38100v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) appear to represent and reason about a large range of phenomena. In particular, recent studies have examined whether LLMs can accurately reason about causation. One of the most commonly used benchmarks for evaluating formal causal reasoning in LLMs is CLadder, a framework for procedural generation of benchmark data sets that was released in 2023. Experiments with CLadder appear to indicate that LLMs can perform formal causal reasoning in a large percentage of generated examples. In this paper, we examine what can be reliably inferred when LLMs perform well on test sets produced by CLadder. We identify several examples of superficial and highly predictive patterns that the CLadder generator embeds in data sets it generates. translated_title: 评估大语言模型中的因果推理：程序化生成挑战的案例研究
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）似乎能够表征并推理广泛的现象。特别是，近期研究考察了LLM能否准确地进行关于因果关系的推理。评估LLM形式化因果推理最常用的基准之一是CLadder，这是一个于2023年发布的用于程序化生成基准数据集的框架。基于CLadder的实验似乎表明，LLM能够在很大比例的生成示例上进行形式化因果推理。在本文中，我们研究了当LLM在CLadder生成的测试集上表现良好时，可以可靠地推断出什么。我们识别出CLadder生成器嵌入在其生成的数据集中的若干表层化且具有高度预测性的模式。我们发现，即使是随机森林这类简单模型，在经过生成数据样本的训练后，也能在CLadder生成的数据集上取得良好表现。我们还发现，许多常……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文揭示CLadder因果推理基准的程序化生成过程中嵌入了表层捷径模式，使得随机森林等简单模型无需真正理解因果即可取得高分，因此LLM在该基准上的优异表现并不能可靠地证明其具备真正的形式化因果推理能力。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that the CLadder benchmark's procedural generation embeds superficial shortcut patterns, allowing even simple models like random forests to perform well, so strong LLM performance on it does not reliably indicate genuine formal causal reasoning ability.
